sfx-swing: A heavy sword whoosh swing through the air, fast, close, no impact. About 0.5 seconds.
sfx-hit: A meaty melee weapon impact on flesh and leather armour, punchy thud with a short crunch. About 0.4 seconds.
sfx-hitbone: A blunt weapon smashing dry bones, brittle crack and clatter. About 0.5 seconds.
sfx-zap: A short sharp electric lightning zap crackle, bright and snappy. About 0.4 seconds.
sfx-thunder: A close lightning strike crack followed by a short deep thunder boom. About 1.5 seconds.
sfx-shadow: A dark magic whoosh, ghostly airy hiss with a low reverse swell, spell cast. About 0.7 seconds.
sfx-bonespear: A bone spear thrown, a hollow rattling whoosh flying past. About 0.6 seconds.
sfx-slam: A huge ground slam impact, rock cracking with a deep boom and debris. About 1.2 seconds.
sfx-warcry: A fierce human battle roar, one short powerful shout of rage, no words. About 1.2 seconds.
sfx-whirl: A continuous fast spinning blade whirling whoosh, loopable. About 2 seconds.
sfx-potion: Drinking a potion: cork pop, quick gulps, a soft magical shimmer. About 1.2 seconds.
sfx-gold: A small handful of gold coins clinking as they are picked up. About 0.5 seconds.
sfx-drop: A metal item clattering onto stone floor. About 0.5 seconds.
sfx-legendary: A legendary item drop: a rising shimmering magical chime with a deep resonant gong and sparkle. About 2 seconds.
sfx-levelup: A triumphant magical level-up sound: bright rising harp glissando with a warm choir swell and chime. About 2 seconds.
sfx-portal: A magical portal opening: swirling whoosh with a deep humming resonance. About 1.5 seconds.
sfx-death-mon: A monster dying: a guttural growl that fades into a wet gurgle. About 1 second.
sfx-death-player: A heavy armoured body falling to the ground, a dull thud and clank, then a low ominous drone. About 2 seconds.
sfx-howl: A big wolf howl, short and fierce. About 1.5 seconds.
sfx-roar: A monstrous giant beast roar, deep and terrifying. About 2 seconds.
sfx-step: A single heavy boot footstep on stone. About 0.3 seconds.
sfx-chest: A heavy wooden treasure chest creaking open with a metal latch. About 1 second.
sfx-waystone: A magical stone activating: a deep resonant hum rising into a crystal chime. About 1.5 seconds.
sfx-arrow: An arrow released from a bow: string twang and a fast whoosh. About 0.5 seconds.
